title: Tuai Leit's Own (miniquest)
start: Speak to Seasinger Jemi on Tuai Leit.

rewards.t: Tuai Leit teleport tablet unlocked in the Waiko Reward Shop

steps.t: Talk to Navigator Jemi (if you have just completed the Harbinger miniquest you may need to relog for the chat option to show up). [Chat: 1 Tuai Leit's Own miniquest. › Accept]
Travel to Tuai Leit.
Talk to Sensei Hakase in the middle of the island.
If you don't have them already, pick 30 rumberries at the south-west farming spot.
Talk twice to Cheri the gnome on the south coast.
Take the rumberry elixir to Lookout Ekahi. [Chat: 1 Tuai Leit's Own miniquest.]

sub.t: Do not exit the dialogue or you will have to get another elixir.

steps.t: Return to Sensei Hakase.
Chop down the inferior bamboo to the west of the island to reach Tuai Leit moai.
Talk to Tuai Leit moai. [Chat: 3 I seek a cure for a spiritual affliction.]
If you don't have them already, harvest 30 positive energy from Cyclosis island.
Travel to Aminishi with some spirit dragon charms.
p: Clearing the way to the Moai

steps.t: Enter the spirit realm via The Well of Spirits in the easternmost part of the island near the Sakadagami.
Talk twice to Yulong in the spirit realm, on the south beach.
Hand him the positive energy to trigger a cutscene with a white flash.

sub.t: Finish dialogue or you have to give positive energy again.

steps.t: Leave the spirit realm. You can quickly leave by exiting to lobby or by logging out then back in.
Talk to Lookout Ekahi. [Chat: 1 Tuai Leit's Own miniquest.]
Talk to Sensei Hakase in Tuai Leit.
Talk to Sensei Seaworth nearby.
Talk to Sojobo in the Waiko marketplace.
Talk to Navigator Jemi. [Chat: 1 Tuai Leit's Own miniquest.]

get_inside.text: Players can travel to Tuai Leit by talking to Quartermaster Gully located in Port Sarim, or Menaphos, after the player has completed the quest Impressing the Locals.
Tuai Leit teleport - Players may break this teletab to teleport to the academy of learning on Tuai Leit. It can be purchased at Boni's Waiko Reward Shop for 5 chimes.
Using the "teleport" right-click option on an Arc journal that has a stored Tuai Leit teleport.
If Azalea Oakheart has been rescued from a castaway island, she will pilot a gnome glider between Tuai Leit and Tree Gnome Stronghold.
